newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Bank Audi readies $75 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Bank Audi readies $75 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Lebanon's Bank Audi is marketting a $75 million Eurobond and the five-year issue is arousing considerable investor interest, Beirut banking sources said on Wednesday.

The bonds, for which application for listing on the London Stock Exchange will be made, are the first tranche of a $200 million Eurobond programme being launched by Bank Audi, one of Lebanon's leading banks, a banker told Reuters.
The issue is lead-managed by Merrill Lynch International and is being marketed in extensive road shows in major U.S. cities, London, Switzerland and the Gulf, the source added.

According to a preliminary term sheet obtained by Reuters, the launch spread is 300-325 basis points over five-year U.S. Treasuries and the issue will be launched in mid-October, maturing in October 2001.
The source said the spread had narrowed to 300-325 bp from 300-350 during the road shows.
The Audi Eurobond will be the first by a Lebanese issuer to have a 144A Tranch, which allows it to be sold to qualified institutional investors in the United States, the sources said.
